name: Divine Grace
summary: A lesson called Divine Grace thanks you for serving the Light. Your example matters to travelers in dangerous lands.

sections.title: A Lesson of Thanks
sections.body: After your service, the Light is praised for the example you set among travelers in dangerous lands. You are offered a lesson in thanks for what you have done.

faq.answer: Divine Grace thanks you for serving the Light and setting an example for travelers in dangerous lands.
The lesson is offered to you in thanks for your service to the Light.
You became an example to travelers in dangerous lands and beyond.
